ResetDynamics returns the chain to its pose at once; the 122 cm step equals how far the fast cell had swung away.
With bBoneSubdivisionCollisionOnly off the inter-bone dummies are free particles, so the polyline folds and real bones draw close (0.03 of rest length).

Body bug, not fixed yet: the WorldSpace teleport branch (AnimNode_KawaiiPhysics.cpp:903) moves bones by the older PrevLocation and skips the simulation, then UpdateOutputLocations outputs Location unrestored. The first link stretches up to 36% for two frames when the component is moving.

Body limitation, not fixed yet: with fixed substepping the bones interpolate between steps while limits stay at the frame's final transform, so in WorldSpace a moving plane overtakes bones and leaves them behind it; the plane only resolves bones near it or crossing it. 60 fps runs one step per frame and stays at 0.

Body bug, not fixed yet: switching SimulationSpace resets the substep pose offsets, so the output interpolation breaks for that one frame. R_ribbon2 drops to 0.83 of its length on every kind of switch, with or without a base bone.
